data.name: Sita
data.gender_notes: Sita is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Furrow; the line made by a plough
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sītā, 'furrow', from the root sī, 'to bind, plough'. Its root is Sanskrit sītā (सीता). Sita, wife of Rama in the Ramayana. Sita is a Sanskrit name meaning “Furrow; the line made by a plough”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sita expresses “Furrow; the line made by a plough”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit sītā, 'furrow', from the root sī, 'to bind, plough'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sita total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
